title: 第71章 天黑了，去给寡妇送衣服

第71章 天黑了，去给寡妇送衣服-《赶山1957：二斤猪肉换个媳妇》

“娘，嫂子，乃香你们进来一下！”李青山将衣服放在桌子上，一屁股坐在了旁边的椅子上道。

“青山，这啥啊？”

老爹李三奎望着用一块布包起来的衣服，鼓鼓囊囊的，好奇道。

“青山，咋了？”

柳桂香和王乃香，老娘也都纷纷走了进来，望了一眼桌子上的包裹后，也是好奇的望着李青山道。

“咱们家的衣服都太破了！”

“这次我特意去了一趟供销社，给你们买了一些衣服回来！”

李青山一边说着，一边将眼前的包裹打开道：“爹，这三套衣服和三双鞋子是你的，这三套是嫂子的，这三套是娘的，这三套是乃香的，还有两条裙子，嫂子和乃香一人一件……！”

一件件衣服被李青山取了出来，一人一份，分好放在桌子上。

“这……！”

“青山，这么多成品衣，得多少钱啊？”

“我，我也有吗？”

“我一把年纪了，要什么新衣服，你这孩子，怎么乱花钱，赶紧把我的这一份退回去！”

“对对对，这么多衣服得不少钱嘞，这又不是逢年过节的，买这么多衣服做什么，赶紧退回去。”

“是啊，青山，你这以后还得娶媳妇呢，这钱得攒着，不能这么花。”

爹娘和嫂子，柳桂香纷纷开口拒绝，想要让李青山将这些成品衣退回去，他们虽然不知道这成品衣多少钱，但肯定不会便宜了，现在就算去买布自己做衣服，一套都要不少钱嘞。

还有这个裙子，肯定更贵了。

都是庄户人家，穿的这么好做什么？

“钱没了还可以再赚，今天咱们全家先把衣服换了，过一阵子，这土房子我打算也推倒了建砖瓦房呢，咱们家以后得日子肯定会越来越好，以后就不要为钱的事情发愁了。”

“反正，这些衣服是不可能退的，你们谁要是不想穿，就直接丢到灶台里面烧了。”

李青山态度坚决道。

“这……！”

“唉……你这孩子，以后可不能这么大手大脚了！”

爹娘等人长叹一口气，无奈之下，也只得听了李青山的，将这些衣裳收下，脸上虽然有些心疼钱，但开心还是真的开心。

“青山，你给叔婶买就算了，我的这个就算了吧？”王乃香咬了咬嘴唇，虽然很喜欢李青山给自己买的衣裳，但还是咬了咬嘴唇将衣裳递了回去道。

柳桂香和李三奎他们都是李青山的亲人。

买衣裳什么的，都无可厚非的，都是一家人，但自己是个怎么回事？

“乃香，我把你从赵贵家中带出来，就肯定会对你的生活负责，以后就不要说这么外道的话了，你要是不想要的话，就丢到土灶里面烧了。”

李青山语气坚决道。

"Mom, sister-in-law, Naixiang, please come in!" Li Qingshan put his clothes on the table and sat down on the chair next to him.

"Qingshan, what is this?"

Father Li Sankui looked at the bulging clothes wrapped in a piece of cloth and asked curiously.

"Qingshan, what's wrong?"

Liu Guixiang, Wang Naixiang, and my mother also walked in. After taking a look at the package on the table, they also looked at Li Qingshan curiously.

"Our clothes are too shabby!"

"This time I went to the supply and marketing cooperative specially and bought some clothes for you!"

As Li Qingshan spoke, he opened the package in front of him and said: "Dad, these three sets of clothes and three pairs of shoes belong to you, these three sets belong to my sister-in-law, these three sets belong to my mother, these three sets belong to Noxiang, and there are two skirts, one for each of my sister-in-law and Noixiang...!"

Li Qingshan took out clothes one by one, one for each person, and placed them on the table.

"This...!"

"Qingshan, how much does it cost to have so many ready-made clothes?"

"Me, do I have it too?"

"I'm so old. I want new clothes. You kid, why are you spending so much money? Please return my share quickly!"

"Yes, yes, so many clothes cost a lot of money. This is not a holiday. What are you buying so many clothes for? Hurry up and return them."

"Yes, Qingshan, you have to marry a wife from now on. You have to save this money and you can't spend it like this."

Her father, mother, sister-in-law, and Liu Guixiang all refused and wanted Li Qingshan to return these finished clothes. Although they didn't know how much the finished clothes cost, they would definitely not be cheap. Even if they buy cloth to make their own clothes now, a set would cost a lot of money.

And this skirt is definitely more expensive.

They are all from the village, so why are they dressed so well?

"If you have no money, you can make it again. Today, our family will change our clothes first. After a while, I plan to knock down this mud house and build a brick house. Our family's life will definitely get better and better in the future. We don't have to worry about money in the future."

"Anyway, these clothes are impossible to return. If any of you don't want to wear them, just throw them into the stove and burn them."

Li Qingshan said firmly.

"This...!"

"Oh...you kid, don't be so lavish in the future!"

The parents and others let out a long sigh. In desperation, they had no choice but to listen to Li Qingshan and accept the clothes. Although their faces looked a little worried about the money, they were still really happy.

"Qingshan, forget about buying it for your uncle and aunt, and forget about mine?" Wang Naixiang bit her lip. Although she liked the clothes Li Qingshan bought for herself, she still bit her lip and handed the clothes back.

Liu Guixiang and Li Sankui are both relatives of Li Qingshan.

There's nothing wrong with buying clothes or anything like that. They're all part of the same family, but what's wrong with him?

"Naixiang, after I brought you out of Zhao Gui's house, I will definitely be responsible for your life. You won't say such unorthodox words in the future. If you don't want it, just throw it into the earthen stove and burn it."

Li Qingshan said firmly.
